owner_calls.question: Raava spends Secret Invasion undercover as James Rhodes, serving President Ritson as his envoy (briefing him in episode 1, speaking for the U.S. at the London summit and firing Fury on behalf of the United States government in episode 2). Undercover service counts, but the screen never names one group for it (Rhodes's own file uses U.S. Air Force, ending at Avengers: Age of Ultron). Add an undercover stage, and under which name?
options: Add ["U.S. Air Force","Secret Invasion"] between two Skrull Rebels stages: [["The Skrull Rebels","Secret Invasion"],["U.S. Air Force","Secret Invasion"],["The Skrull Rebels","Secret Invasion"]]
Add a U.S. government stage under a new name the owner picks
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: Gravik tasks Raava to impersonate Rhodes and use his influence in the U.S. government. As Rhodes she reports to Ritson in 'Resurrection' (ep 1), and in 'Promises' (ep 2) she attends the world leaders' meeting for Ritson and tells Fury he is being fired by the United States government. Unmasked in ep 5.
